result.instructions: Tools for Mighty Networks, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which spaces in our community have the most members?"; "Show me the posts in the Announcements space from this week and their comment counts."; "List the upcoming events and how many members have RSVP'd yes.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Mighty Networks data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run mightynetworks_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run mightynetworks_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run mightynetworks_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. mightynetworks_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: mightynetworks_get_me
tools.title: Get the authenticated host
tools.description: Return the account that owns this API key: its id, name and roles. Good first call to check that the key works.

tools.name: mightynetworks_get_network
tools.title: Get the network
tools.description: Return the network's title, slug, description, URL, creation time and billing plan name.

tools.name: mightynetworks_list_spaces
tools.title: List spaces
tools.description: List the network's spaces (groups or channels) with title, URL, member count and archived flag. Page with the returned endCursor.

after.description: Cursor from the previous page's pageInfo.endCursor.

tools.name: mightynetworks_get_space
tools.title: Get a space
tools.description: Return one space by its id or URL slug: title, URL, member count, archived flag and creation time.

tools.name: mightynetworks_list_space_posts
tools.title: List posts in a space
tools.description: List the posts in one space, newest first, with title, plain-text body, author and comment count.

after.description: Cursor from the previous page's pageInfo.endCursor.

tools.name: mightynetworks_get_post
tools.title: Get a post
tools.description: Return one post by its id or URL slug, with its plain-text body, author, space, status and comment count.

tools.name: mightynetworks_list_comments
tools.title: List comments on a post
tools.description: List the comments on one post with plain-text body, author, thread depth and reply count. Set root_only to skip replies.

after.description: Cursor from the previous page's pageInfo.endCursor.

tools.name: mightynetworks_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List network members with name, join date, member type, role and last activity. Emails are not returned. Filter by role or member type. Page with the returned endCursor.

after.description: Cursor from the previous page's pageInfo.endCursor.

tools.name: mightynetworks_get_member
tools.title: Get a member
tools.description: Return one member by id: name, location, join date, member type, roles and follower counts. Emails are not returned.

tools.name: mightynetworks_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List upcoming or past event occurrences with title, start and end times, URL and RSVP counts. Optionally limit to one space.

space_id.description: Limit to events in this space id.

tools.name: mightynetworks_create_post
tools.title: Create a post
tools.description: Create a post in a space as the host. Default status is DRAFT (not visible to members). POSTED publishes it to the space right away. notify false (default) sends no member notification.

space_id.description: Space id (resource id or GlobalID) to post in.

body.description: Post body as HTML (sanitized by Mighty Networks).

tools.name: mightynetworks_create_comment
tools.title: Create a comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a post as the host. Pass reply_to_id to reply inside a thread.

post_id.description: Post id (resource id or GlobalID) to comment on.

body.description: Comment text (HTML is sanitized by Mighty Networks).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Mighty Networks
prompts.description: What you can do with Mighty Networks here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: compare_the_member_count_of_each_space
prompts.title: Compare the member count of each space
prompts.description: List the spaces of the network with their titles, URLs and member counts. Open one space for its creation date and archived flag.

prompts.name: review_recent_posts_and_their_comments
prompts.title: Review recent posts and their comments
prompts.description: List the posts of one space, newest first, with comment counts. Read one post, then its comments, including the replies.

prompts.name: check_upcoming_events_and_rsvp_counts
prompts.title: Check upcoming events and RSVP counts
prompts.description: List upcoming or past events, optionally for one space, with their start times and RSVP counts.

prompts.name: look_up_members_by_role
prompts.title: Look up members by role
prompts.description: List members, filtered by role or member type, with their join dates and last activity. Member emails are not returned.

prompts.name: draft_a_post_for_review_before_it_goes_live
prompts.title: Draft a post for review before it goes live
prompts.description: Create a post in a space. It stays a draft, which members cannot see, until it is set to posted. Members get no notice by default.

prompts.name: reply_to_a_member_comment
prompts.title: Reply to a member comment
prompts.description: Read the comments on a post. Add a comment as the host, or pass a comment id to reply inside a thread.
